data.name: DynamicCustomProperty.ConfigurationModal.Title
data.value: Configure Commands used to define corresponding Custom Properties

data.name: DynamicCustomProperty.ConfigurationModal.Instructions
data.value: Specify the command to be used to retrieve information to display for the relevant custom property. Any field left blank will be ignored. All Windows commands are piped to powershell.

data.name: DynamicCustomProperty.ConfigurationModal.VariableInstructions
data.value: Current values for custom properties can be included via the variable $SCCustomPropertyX. Single quotes are escaped for powershell. For example, to include the current value of CustomProperty1 in the Command, it would be $SCCustomProperty1.
